basic_details.job_title: TMB Credit Trainer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. (TMB) has notified the recruitment for Credit Trainer posts on a contract basis for a period of 6 months under its 2026 recruitment. The position carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 50,000 per month, with no other allowances or perquisites. Eligible applicants must be retired officers of banks or other banks in Scale III or above cadre with a good track record and unblemished service. Candidates can apply online by registering with a valid email ID and mobile number and uploading the required documents from 17 October 2026 to 31 October 2026. The selection process c

how_to_apply: Candidates are requested to log on to the Bank’s website (https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/). Click “Apply Online” and register themselves for the appropriate post.
Register with a valid personal email ID and mobile number to create a User ID.
Note down the Unique Registration Number and Password sent to your mobile number and email for applying online.
Click the activation link sent to the registered E-mail ID which will direct to the Careers portal.
Login with the Application number (Registration Number/Username) and password on the right side of the career portal.
Fill in all details in the online application at appropriate places very carefully, ensuring names match certificates exactly, and click “Save/ Continue”.
Upload photograph with the dimension of 390 X 520 pixels (preferred) and ensure the size of the scanned image is not more than 120 KB.
Upload signature with the dimension of 240 X 240 pixels (preferred) and ensure the size of the scanned image is not more than 60 KB (Signature in Capital letters shall NOT be accepted).

Upload the following enclosures to be uploaded along with the e-application and ensure the size of the scanned image is not more than 250 KB: Self-attested photo copy of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate for age proof, Self-attested photo copy of Degree Certificate/s, Experience certificate/s and Relieving Letter for pervious employments, and Last Month Salary Slip.

On successful submission of the Online Application form, click confirm/submit on bottom of the page and a message “Registration is successful” will be displayed. A copy of the system generated online application form will be sent to the registered Email ID and the Candidates should take a printout of the same for future reference.
important_instructions: Please note that the e-applications with incorrect / incomplete particulars or without copies of certificates attached as required above are liable to be rejected. The Bank reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason and Bank's decision in the matter of eligibility, interview and selection would be final. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. The job role and location is subject to transferable based on requirements, and the posting will be at Anywhere in India. Kindly note that the candidates are advised to adhere to the eligibility conditions given strictly. Any information found to be wrong or any candidate found ineligible at any stage of the process or later will result in disqualification of the candidate.

content_sections.heading: TMB Credit Trainer at a Glance

rows.details: Select Regional Office of the Bank – Coimbatore, Chennai, Madurai, Salem, Tirunelveli and Trichy (Subject to transferable based on requirements; Posting will be at Anywhere in India)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following eligibility conditions as specified in the official notification: Retirement Status: The retired officers of our banks/other banks are eligible for selection from the date of retirement. Cadre Requirement: The officers should have been in Scale III or above cadre during retirement. Previous work experience in the Credit Department will be given preference. Track Record: Only suitable persons with a good track record to suit the bank's requirement will be engaged on a contract basis. Officers with unblemished service alone are eligible to apply. Disqualification: Officers who were removed /dismissed from the bank's service under disciplinary measures are not eligible. Age Limit: Not more than 62 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of ₹50,000/- per month for a contract period of 6 months. No other allowance or perquisites including bonus/ex-gratia/variable pay, LFC and medical reimbursement as admissible to the regular employees of the bank will be paid/given. content_sections.heading: TMB Credit Trainer Job Description
content_sections.text: The roles and responsibilities assigned to Credit Trainers include: Deliver training programs on banking products, credit policies, and loan processes. Train employees on retail, MSME, housing, and personal loan underwriting procedures. Explain credit appraisal techniques, financial analysis, and risk assessment methods. Conduct sessions on documentation, compliance, KYC, and regulatory guidelines. Develop training materials, presentations, case studies, and assessment modules. Support new joiners during induction and onboarding programs. Monitor trainee performance through tests, assignments, and practical evaluations. Provide coaching on customer handling, sales quality, and portfolio management. Ensure employees understand bank policies related to NPA control and recovery practices. Coordinate with business teams and credit departments for process updates. Identify training needs and recommend skill development initiatives. Maintain training records, attendance, certifications, and MIS reports. Conduct refresher training programs whenever policy or product changes occur. Assist branches and field teams in improving credit quality and operational efficiency. Support audit readiness and adherence to internal credit standards. Any other work assigned by the Bank.

faq.question: Q1. What is the TMB Credit Trainer recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. has invited applications from dynamic and result-oriented individuals, specifically retired officers, to engage them as Credit Trainers on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for TMB Credit Trainer 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not state a specific numerical total vacancy count, but lists openings for select Regional Offices.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for TMB Credit Trainer?
faq.answer: The closing date for registering Online e-application is 31.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for the TMB Credit Trainer post?
faq.answer: Retired officers of TMB/other banks who were in Scale III or above cadre during retirement, aged not more than 62 years, with unblemished service are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for TMB Credit Trainer?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive a consolidated pay of ₹50,000/- per month with no other allowance or perquisites.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for TMB Credit Trainer?
faq.answer: No, the application fee is Nil.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for TMB Credit Trainer?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply only ON-LINE through TMB’s website https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/ by registering with a correct email ID/mobile number, filling out the application, and uploading required certificates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for TMB Credit Trainer?
faq.answer: The shortlisted candidates should appear for interview through Direct / Video Conferencing.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired employees from other banks apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the retired officers of our banks/other banks are eligible for selection from the date of retirement provided they were in Scale III or above cadre.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: At select Regional Office of the Bank – Coimbatore, Chennai, Madurai, Salem, Tirunelveli and Trichy, and the posting will be at Anywhere in India subject to transfer based on requirements.
